note: Renders: scratchpad/w17 (m01-m19) and w17q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575, built from the candidate (3ea3f24 + e6d3072 + fed7fdc in 10_mono.js). I diffed each frame pixel by pixel against scratchpad/w16 and w16q (script raterB17/diff.py, magenta maps raterB17/d_*.png). The m11 and much of the m08 change comes from the econ commits that landed between the two builds, not from monuments. The monument changes are all where the commit message says they are, and q01, m07, m10 and m15 are essentially unchanged (0.03 to 0.23 % of pixels). Every round-16 low issue except the door-1 wood got a real response. The ash on the bar, the welcome lower doors and the door-2 ash wall is now fine: m04 (150,250,370,500) std fell from 10.4 to 3.2 and the q11 bar doors from 9.6 to 3.3, level with the lav doors at 3.5. The ash-wall frames now have rounded outer corners and dark red clips straddling the top rail. The welcome cabinet has a D-boss with a horizontal oval and thumb-turn, and its tag now sits above the monitor. The bar has a bright flush nosing and grey glass tumblers with full rims. The galley inserts have proud bar handles and slightly darker frames, the jump seats have flat webbing with buckles, the bassinet bar is gone, and the door-2 soffit has a steel fascia. The weak points that remain are new, smaller ones. The welcome-glass cue is two crisp hairlines that read like wires leaning inside the cabinet. The ash-wall highlight strips are detached and stop short, and the frame openings still have square inner corners. The bar nosing does not wrap the counter ends, and the bar end stile is still coarse. The q01 door-1 wood has not changed. Lighting is noted but not scored: q19 still whites out the rear galley ceiling. Scripts: raterB17/s.py (mean / p10 / p90 by luminance, std), pair.py (w16 over w17 crops). Close-ups: raterB17/c_m04.png, c_m03.png, c_m05t.png, c_q11r.png, c_m09.png, c_m13.png.

issues.problem: The glass cue is two crisp, constant-width diagonal hairlines that stop short of the pane frame. In m16 they read as two wires or sticks leaning inside the cabinet, not as a reflection on the glass.
issues.evidence: In the m03 pane (560,180,680,420) the line pixels reach luminance 153 against a pane median of 42, and 563 pixels are above 110. omaat_room_32 shows a soft, broad, low-contrast light patch across the left part of the pane, with no hard lines (raterB17/c_m03.png, p_m16.png).
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley in 10_mono.js, replace the two thin quads (bw 0.006 / 0.003 with #8e8c89 / #7a7876) with one transparent quad covering the whole pane: {c:'#9a9894', r:0.05, m:0.6, a:0.12}. If the engine cannot do alpha here, use one wide quad (bw about 0.16) only a few levels above the contents (#3c3b3b) and run it edge to edge, so it ends at the pane frame instead of floating.

issues.detail: Door-2 ash-wall frame highlights and inner corners (m04)
issues.problem: The lit and shadow strips are separate quads that stop short. The top strip is broken by the clip plate, and the right vertical strip floats from mid-height. The opening inside the rounded frame is a square-cornered rectangle. The clips are lighter than the photo.
issues.evidence: The m04 right frame column (388,300,400,500) has std 16.1 (was 7.1) because of the bright floating strip. The clips sample #b23d32 against the lalf_133 clips at #66201a. In lalf_133 the inner opening also has rounded corners (raterB17/c_m04.png).
issues.fix: In the door-2 ash-wall builder in 10_mono.js, make the ash panel gPlate(pw, 0.85, 0.012, 0.04) instead of gRBoxM so the inner corners round. Extend the L side strip to the full straight length (0.91 - 2*0.08) and keep the strips off the clip plate. Darken flapTab to about '#6e2318'.

issues.detail: Bar nosing ends and end stile (q11, m06)
issues.problem: The bright nosing runs along the front edge only. At the counter ends the dark slab edge shows with no band. The bar's outboard end stile still has the coarse ash grain.
issues.evidence: In raterB17/c_q11r.png the counter end is a dark edge. q11 (565,150,595,330) has std 20.3, against 3.3 on the bar doors. samchui_render_11 shows the band wrapping the corner.
issues.fix: In buildBar in 10_mono.js, add two short steelBright nosing pieces (0.012 x 0.045 x counter depth) at each end of the deck at the same height as the front band. Switch the end-stile material to barAsh (the ashDoor layer).

issues.problem: The frames darkened only slightly and still read close to the face tone.
issues.evidence: m09 (140,10,152,200) is #9d9c99, against #afaeaa on the faces (180,40,290,150), a ratio of about 0.9. In sansY_44 the frame gaps read clearly darker.
issues.fix: In 10_mono.js, lower the insert frame colour from '#9a968f' to about '#85817a', or add a 4 mm dark insertSeam strip along each frame edge.

issues.problem: Carried over unchanged. The wood shows radial streak aliasing at grazing angles, and the hue is a neutral mauve rather than warm brown.
issues.evidence: q01 (50,50,330,500) is identical to w16 at #3f3737 with std 13.1. The omaatF_2 dark wood is #2c2217 to #362d25.
issues.fix: In 10_mono.js, lower the fWood layer contrast on the F monument walls, or use darkWood c '#3a302a'.

issues.problem: The tumblers are now grey cups with rims, but the bodies are opaque, so they do not read as clear rocks glasses.
issues.evidence: In raterB17/c_m05t.png the bodies are flat mid-grey (#6a6e72) with the counter hidden behind them. In samchui_render_11 the glasses are clear, with only rims and bases bright.
issues.fix: In 10_mono.js, give MONMAT.tumbler alpha (a about 0.35) if the engine's glass path allows it. Otherwise darken the body toward the counter tone (#3a3c40) and keep the bright rim and base, so the glass reads by its edges.

gapWorth03: A soft, frame-to-frame pane reflection instead of the hairlines would take the welcome galley to about 8.7. Rounded inner corners, continuous highlights and darker clips would do the same for the ash wall, and end nosings with a fine-grain end stile would take the bar to about 8.8. Together they would lift the area to about 8.7. The door-1 wood and the lav doors are now the lowest details, so fixing the q01 wood would be worth about another 0.1 overall.
